# Ethosoft

> Ethosoft is an interdisciplinary artificial intelligence research team working across language models, healthcare, education, and core AI.

## Research papers

- [NEDOQwen](https://ethosoft.org/papers/nedoqwen/): A 2026 Research Square preprint presenting an auditable, low-cost diagnosis-and-repair study for a Turkish-centric 824M-parameter language model. The page links DOI 10.21203/rs.3.rs-10384535/v1, a local usage guide, source code, two public model checkpoints, and two training datasets.
- [Foresight Is Not Enough](https://ethosoft.org/papers/foresight-is-not-enough/): A 2026 preprint examining sentence-level future prediction, self-loop hard negatives, semantic reranking, and the representation-to-behavior calibration gap in small language models. DOI: 10.21203/rs.3.rs-10331341/v1.
- [Testing Surprisal as a Compute-Allocation Signal](https://ethosoft.org/papers/surprise/): A 2026 preregistered long-horizon development study testing causal surprisal routing in a byte-level hybrid attention/Mamba-2 language model. The intermediate advantage disappears at the 50,000-step endpoint, and the sealed final test is not opened. DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.21718745. [Source code](https://github.com/NMSOfficial/surprise-ca).
- [When Safety Is Not Load-Bearing](https://ethosoft.org/papers/mycelium/): The MYCELIUM counterfactual dependability study of mandatory-path safety mechanisms in language models. The work is accepted for COLM 2026 Workshop AIMS, while the IEEE TDSC manuscript is under review. Its public-safe Zenodo artifact reports a negative behavioral load-bearing result. Concept DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.21275744. [Source code](https://github.com/NMSOfficial/mycelium).
- [When Training Order Becomes the Algorithm](https://ethosoft.org/papers/epilang/): An EpiLang preprint studying endpoint-induced collapse and memorization without systematic rule generalization in a controlled modulo-11 register-language task. DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.21718516. [Source code](https://github.com/NMSOfficial/EpiLang).

## Research index

- [Goal Drift](https://ethosoft.org/papers/goal-drift/): An OpenReview preprint on objective revision, goal preservation, and alignment in capable AI systems. [Original PDF](https://openreview.net/pdf?id=DZTz8rXtqH) · [OpenReview record](https://openreview.net/forum?id=DZTz8rXtqH).

- [Ethosoft Papers](https://ethosoft.org/papers/): The canonical index of Ethosoft preprints and technical reports.
- [Ethosoft Works](https://ethosoft.org/works/): The canonical archive of Ethosoft projects, prototypes, competition systems, open models, datasets, benchmarks, and ongoing applied AI work.
- [Ethosoft Open Research](https://ethosoft.org/#research): The overview of Ethosoft papers, open-source models, prototypes, benchmark datasets, and controlled experiments.
- [Ethosoft Projects](https://ethosoft.org/works/): Detailed, maturity-aware records of healthcare, education, computational-science, and responsible-technology projects.
- [Ethosoft Team](https://ethosoft.org/#team): Team members and research contributors.

## Models and adapters

- [Qwen3-1.7B ResearchReasoning JSON RL](https://ethosoft.org/models/qwen3-research-reasoning-json-rl/): A detailed research page for the LoRA/PEFT adapter covering evidence-grounded research QA, source selection, claim verification, uncertainty reporting, strict JSON generation, diagnostic results, artifacts, and limitations.
- [Qwen3-1.7B ResearchReasoning JSON RL GGUF](https://huggingface.co/Ethosoft/Qwen3-1.7B-ResearchReasoning-JSON-RL-GGUF): GGUF quantizations of the research-reasoning adapter for local inference.
- [QA-Research-SLM](https://github.com/Ahmet2001/QA-research-SLM): Training, evaluation, and reproducibility code for the research-reasoning adapter.

## Projects and works

- [Epilepsy Early-Warning System](https://ethosoft.org/works/epilepsy-early-warning-system/): An eight-channel EEG and edge-AI research prototype covering ictal, preictal, postictal, and normal states; its warning horizon remains a design target rather than a clinically validated result.
- [Explainable Cardiomegaly Screening](https://ethosoft.org/works/explainable-cardiomegaly-screening/): A competition system combining heart and lung segmentation, cardiothoracic measurements, CNN evidence, and LightGBM classification on frontal chest X-rays.
- [Colonoscopy Polyp Segmentation](https://ethosoft.org/works/colonoscopy-polyp-segmentation/): A multi-dataset U-Net-family study that documents validation performance, augmentation ablations, and cross-dataset variability.
- [Ultrasound Heart-Failure Assessment](https://ethosoft.org/works/ultrasound-heart-failure-assessment/): An echocardiography-video concept for left-ventricle segmentation, volume estimation, and ejection-fraction decision support.
- [Protein Mutation Modeling and G6PD Screening](https://ethosoft.org/works/protein-mutation-and-drug-screening/): Linked AlphaFold, GNN, and sequence-ensemble mutation experiments plus a GNINA comparison of wild-type and R166H G6PD binding profiles over 3,799 filtered DrugCentral molecules.
- [MODY2 Variant Classification](https://ethosoft.org/works/mody2-variant-classification/): An exploratory 356-variant GCK study using 3-mer encoding and ensemble classification.
- [Fundus and OCT Eye Analysis](https://ethosoft.org/works/fundus-and-oct-eye-analysis/): A prototype concept for multimodal eye-disease classification and lesion localization.
- [AI Digital Stethoscope](https://ethosoft.org/works/ai-digital-stethoscope/): A heart-sound preprocessing, feature-extraction, and murmur-screening concept.
- [Neuropathy and Myopathy EMG Analysis](https://ethosoft.org/works/neuropathy-and-myopathy-emg-analysis/): An early EMG research direction listed without implementation or performance claims.
- [Traffic-Aware Eco-Routing](https://ethosoft.org/works/traffic-aware-eco-routing/): A Flutter route-planning prototype combining graph search with vehicle- and traffic-aware fuel modeling.
- [AI English Exam Evaluation](https://ethosoft.org/works/ai-english-exam-evaluation/): A teacher-configurable writing, listening, reading, and speaking assessment prototype.
- [Studium AI Study Coach](https://ethosoft.org/works/studium-ai-study-coach/): A cross-platform YKS planning and study-analysis product concept.
- [Context-Aware Cyberbullying Protection](https://ethosoft.org/works/context-aware-cyberbullying-protection/): A multilingual moderation and online-wellbeing concept with explicit privacy, appeal, and bias-testing requirements.
- [Machine Learning for Collider Events](https://ethosoft.org/works/machine-learning-for-collider-events/): A research design for signal-versus-background learning on CERN/LHC collision and Monte Carlo data.
- [AI Music Scoring](https://ethosoft.org/works/ai-music-scoring/): An integrated audio-and-lyrics pipeline using Demucs, Whisper, rhyme and redif analysis, DistilBERT, logistic regression, MFCC features, and Gradient Boosting to produce a genre-aware 0–100 score.
- [DART-RIFT](https://ethosoft.org/works/dart-rift/): An open GPU-accelerated SPH shock-physics and Bayesian-inference project for probabilistically estimating Dimorphos interior structure from DART impact observables. [Repository](https://github.com/Yagiz-D-Ekrem-Dolar/dart-rift).

## Experiments and benchmarks

- [Risk-Routed Heterogeneous KV Memory](https://ethosoft.org/experiments/risk-routed-heterogeneous-kv-memory/): A detailed experiment page investigating KV-cache compression as fidelity routing, with full KV precision for exact-critical spans and low-bit quantized KV for lower-risk background context.
- [Risk-Routed KV Exact-Recall Benchmark](https://huggingface.co/datasets/Mandotosh/risk-routed-kv-exact-recall-benchmark): The public benchmark dataset for the project.

- [Yağız Ekrem Dalar](https://ethosoft.org/person/yagiz-ekrem-dalar/): Ethosoft communications lead, AI researcher, and data engineer working on multimodal AI, reinforcement learning, Turkish NLP, and reproducible systems.
- [Nedim Mutlu Sezer](https://ethosoft.org/person/nedim-mutlu-sezer/): Ethosoft co-founder and CTO, AI researcher, and project lead working on model evaluation, Turkish language models, biomedical AI, multimodal learning, and high-performance scientific computing.
- [Ömer Faruk Aksoy](https://ethosoft.org/person/omer-faruk-aksoy/): Ethosoft captain and AI researcher working on computer vision, generative media, education technology, space-data processing, and scalable AI pipelines.
- [Feyzi Arda Salihoğlu](https://ethosoft.org/person/feyzi-arda-salihoglu/): Ethosoft strategy lead and AI/data engineer contributing to language-model research, multimodal systems, reproducible experiments, and applied AI projects.
